title.ko: 은유와 개념적 은유: time is money · argument is war · journey · vehicle and tenor · dead metaphor
title.en: metaphor and conceptual metaphor: time is money, argument is war, journey, vehicle and tenor, dead metaphor

explain.ko: 은유(metaphor)는 한 대상을 다른 대상으로 말하는 비유로, 본뜻(tenor)과 매개(vehicle)로 분석합니다. 직유(simile)는 like, as로 비교를 드러냅니다. 개념적 은유 이론은 은유가 단순한 장식이 아니라 사고의 방식이라고 봅니다. 시간은 돈이다(spend, save, waste), 논쟁은 전쟁이다(attack, defend)처럼 일상에 스며든 은유가 많습니다. 죽은 은유(table leg)는 이미 은유로 느껴지지 않고, 혼합 은유는 이미지를 흐리게 합니다.
explain.en: Metaphor speaks of one thing as another, and is analysed in terms of tenor and vehicle. A simile makes the comparison explicit with like or as. Conceptual metaphor theory holds that metaphor is not mere decoration but a way of thinking. Many metaphors permeate daily language: time is money (spend, save, waste), argument is war (attack, defend). Dead metaphors (table leg) no longer feel metaphorical, and mixed metaphors blur the image.

notes.en: Analyse by separating tenor and vehicle.
Replace clichéd metaphors with fresh images.

items.passage:
LANGUAGE COLUMN
Thinking in metaphor
We spend and save time as if it were money. Such metaphors are so deeply embedded in daily language that we mostly fail to notice them. But once we notice metaphor, we can examine our frames of thought critically.

prompt.en: Write four sentences using a metaphor and identify its tenor and vehicle in the last sentence.

task.model: Life is a long journey. We lose our way and sometimes find shortcuts. The image evokes a life searching for direction. In this metaphor the tenor is life and the vehicle is the journey.

model_trans.en: Life is a long journey. We lose our way and sometimes find shortcuts. The image evokes a life searching for direction. In this metaphor the tenor is life and the vehicle is the journey.
